solaris_resources.glyph_desc.convert_wat: Converts standalone water source blocks within a 3×3×3 area centered on the target into 4 Crystallized Water each. Flowing water and waterlogged blocks are not consumed.
solaris_resources.glyph_desc.dissolve_wa: Dissolves Crystallized Water within a 3×3×3 area above the target into unstable Hydrogen and Oxygen atoms: 16 Hydrogen and 8 Oxygen per unit.
solaris_resources.glyph_name.assembly_at: Unstable Mana Atom Assembly Type I
solaris_resources.glyph_desc.assembly_at: Randomly assembles unstable Hydrogen atoms within a 3×3×3 area above the target into unstable Iron, Carbon and Copper atoms.
solaris_resources.glyph_name.aggregation: Unstable Mana Atom Aggregation Type I
solaris_resources.glyph_desc.aggregation: Aggregates atoms within a 3×3×3 area above the target into items according to the configuration, splitting the drops by their maximum stack size.
